plan: With a high private value of $35, I want to secure the item. Since this is a single round with no prior history, I'll use an aggressive strategy. My sealed bid needs to be high enough to discourage competitors but not so high that I lose money if I win. I'll bid close to my value but leave room for potential profit. A bid around $32-$33 seems optimal - high enough to likely win, but preserving some potential profit margin.

Since this is a single round with no prior history, I'll bid strategically near my true value. A bid slightly above my value but not revealing my full valuation could help me win while preserving potential profit margin. I'll aim to bid around $45 to signal serious intent without overpaying.

With a private value of $44, my goal is to maximize potential profit. In a single-round sealed bid auction, I want to bid strategically.
